newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Jan-April shipbuilding orders soar.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Jan-April shipbuilding orders soar.

text.p: South Korean shipyards won orders totalling 2.87 million gross tons for 42 ships in the first four months of this year, up from 1.19 million gross tons for 25 ships a year ago, shipbuilders said on Tuesday.

The Korea Shipbuilders' Association said all ships were for export. The association said completed ships in the period totalled 1.952 million gross tons for 45 ships, against 1.946 million gross tons for 47 ships a year ago.
Backlogged orders at the end of April stood at 14.02 million gross tons (276 ships), compared with 13.12 million gross tons (288 ships) a year ago, the association said.
